title: Fixed-length action prefix
statement: Let $k,n$ be natural numbers, and let $a$ be an action of a $k$-tape Turing machine with Boolean work-tape symbols and successor states in $	ext{Fin}(n+1)$. Its action-bit encoding is the concatenation of a Boolean list of length $4k+4$ and the encoding of its optional successor state.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ is an action with $k$ work tapes, Boolean tape symbols, and successor state in $\mathrm{Fin}(n+1)$
